output.reason: Asymptomatic patient requesting STI screening after a new partner needs a clinician to select and order the appropriate tests, which messaging can start without urgency.
output.patientMessage: A Counsel clinician can pick up this request in this thread to arrange STI screening and advise which tests fit your recent exposure; no emergency care is needed. Testing is worthwhile even without symptoms, since many STIs cause none. If you develop genital sores, unusual discharge, painful urination, fever or pelvic/abdominal pain, seek medical care promptly rather than waiting for a reply.

redFlags.concern: Known partner STI diagnosis or specific exposure concern

output.vitalSigns: No vital signs reported; whether any were measured is unknown.
output.evidenceLimitations: Consumer health summaries support general STI testing advice but not individual test selection or eligibility for this patient.

citations.claim: Sexually active people should discuss STI risk and testing with a provider, especially as many STIs cause no symptoms.
citations.limitation: Consumer summary; does not specify which tests this patient needs.

citations.claim: Infection can be present without symptoms, so absence of symptoms does not exclude STI.
